title: durable broker channel whose only consumer is a projection fold on another deployable
note: the consumer deployable has a fold and no reactor.  The channel plan's `consumesFromBroker` counts the fold, so every backend emits and starts a broker consumer on `shipApi`; a backend that keys the consumer on a non-projection subscription emits none and the projection never folds.  The behavioural cell (place on salesApi → OrderBook row on shipApi) needs the broker sidecar.

apiCaller.e2eLess: BROKER SIDECAR: the claim (place on salesApi, an OrderBook row on shipApi) needs a broker between two booted services, and the real-process legs cannot boot a wired deployable without a broker URL (#5613).  Until then the compile tier and test/generator/channel-consumer-wiring.test.ts carry the consumer wiring.
